talopsia.name: TALOPSIA Profile
talopsia.forcedChoiceInstruction: Which of these two statements describes you best?

report.title: TALOPSIA Profile
report.disclaimer: This profile describes tendencies reported by the candidate, expressed as an intensity from 1 (very low) to 5 (very high). It is neither a diagnosis nor a judgment of the candidate's worth, and should be complemented by an interview.
report.patternsHint: Combinations of intensities observed across several dimensions, to explore in interview. These are not psychological types.
report.noPatterns: No marked combination of tendencies was identified.
report.error: Unable to load the TALOPSIA profile.
report.candidateShareHint: Preview of the report intended for the candidate. It is never sent automatically: you decide whether to share it.
report.patternsHintCandidate: Combinations of tendencies emerging from your answers. These are not psychological types.

interviewGuide.title: Interview guide
interviewGuide.hint: Topics to explore during the interview — not conclusions.

P01.label: Collaborative autonomy
P01.description: Tends to work independently while staying oriented towards collective work.

P02.label: Rigorous performance
P02.description: Tends to combine a drive for results with high quality standards.

P03.label: Reliable organization
P03.description: Tends to rely on keeping commitments and a structured organization.

P04.label: Adaptation and exploration
P04.description: Tends to seek novelty and readily adjust the way of working.

P05.label: Relational leadership
P05.description: Tends to take a leading role while relying on cooperation.

P06.label: Structured influence
P06.description: Tends to defend positions based on an analysis of the situation.

P07.label: Stability under pressure
P07.description: Tends to remain emotionally stable and effective in demanding contexts.

P08.label: Responsible autonomy
P08.description: Tends to act independently with a strong sense of commitment.

P09.label: Results/rigor tension
P09.description: Strong results orientation with lower intensity in rigor: a point to explore in interview (speed vs. checking).

P10.label: Rigor/results tension
P10.description: Strong rigor with lower intensity in results orientation: a point to explore in interview (quality vs. deadlines).

P11.label: Autonomy/cooperation tension
P11.description: Strong autonomy with lower intensity in cooperation: a point to explore in interview (teamwork).

P12.label: Cooperation / low influence
P12.description: Strong cooperation with lower intensity in influence: a point to explore in interview (voicing one's positions).

P13.label: Adaptability / low organization
P13.description: Strong adaptability with lower intensity in organization: a point to explore in interview (structuring work).

P14.label: Organization / low adaptability
P14.description: Strong organization with lower intensity in adaptability: a point to explore in interview (response to change).

P15.label: Assertive leadership
P15.description: Tends to take the lead and put forward ideas.

P16.label: Reinforced relational leadership
P16.description: Tends to lead through cooperation, with at least moderate influence.

P17.label: Autonomous leadership
P17.description: Tends to take on leadership responsibilities independently.

P18.label: Structured execution
P18.description: Tends to carry out work in an organized, reliable and precise way.

P19.label: Structured autonomous performance
P19.description: Tends to pursue results in an independent and organized way.

P20.label: Adaptive performance
P20.description: Tends to pursue results while adjusting the way of working.

P21.label: Social communication
P21.description: Tends to seek interaction and put forward ideas.

P22.label: Influence without strong sociability
P22.description: Strong influence, with a lower preference for frequent social interaction.

P23.label: Relational cooperation
P23.description: Tends to favour harmonious relationships and collective work.

P24.label: Exploration and learning
P24.description: Tends to seek novelty, adapt, and evolve practices through learning.

P25.label: Low-adaptability structure
P25.description: Strong organization and reliability with lower intensity in adaptability: a point to explore in interview.

P26.label: Structured resilience
P26.description: Tends to remain stable under pressure, relying on a reliable way of working.

P27.label: Results-oriented resilience
P27.description: Tends to stay focused on results in demanding contexts.

jobProfile.hint: Set how important each dimension is for this position. Importance is not a minimum score: it only describes how assessed candidates align, and never filters or ranks them automatically.
